narr: A storm system brought flash flooding and high winds to portions of southern Utah and severe thunderstorm wind gusts to portions of northern Utah.
ev: A flash flood wave of 1000 CFS was recorded by the Paria River near Kanab gauge, with multiple smaller flood waves following. A single large flood wave of 3000 CFS was observed father downstream at Lees Ferry.

A Zion National Park official reported that Pine Creek experienced a flash flood.
